name: lesson-pack-template
title: Lesson pack template (multi-canvas curriculum)
description: TEMPLATE — copy this directory into ~/.claude/duo/packs/<your-pack-name>/ and customize PACK.json (name + title + description), canvases, and lesson-skill to ship your own multi-canvas curriculum. Originally drafted as 'claude-code-basics' (Stage 28); retired from the default install in v0.6.13 because the curriculum content was never fleshed out past skeletons. Kept as an example of a multi-canvas pack shape (orientation launcher + 7 family canvases). For the canonical curriculum pattern, see ~/.claude/skills/duo/examples/curriculum-template/.
